toolchain_labeling.rule: Only a compiler executable that Amu itself produced (selfhost-built native image, compiler binary SHA-256 recorded) produces 'selfhost result' numbers. Everything compiled via bin/amu (Node bootstrap) is 'bootstrap reference' and must never be published as selfhost (amu AGENTS.md; docs/selfhost-priority.md rules 2 and 4). The C loader (kexe_loader.c) is trusted bootstrap infrastructure in both cases.
toolchain_labeling.selfhost_status_20261019: A selfhost-built compiler exists (amu/seed/bootstrap/adopted-20261012.bin, sha256 47fba216e1a65b892458216575bbb70be228d86f4b7a6d73ebae84230279f20b; on-host G1 self-build reproduces the fixed point in ~42 s) but cannot compile GPU guests: E2115 refuses :gpu/compute (seed 21-check admits wires 3 20 23 33 34 35 37 38 39 41 only) and drv-r5b-gate refuses explicit --policy with E2170. All decode numbers in this file are therefore bootstrap reference.
